title: Arista AVD Schema
description: AVD schema document. A document must declare type: dict; its child schemas describe the supported input values.

oneOf.description: Root dictionary of a named AVD schema. It can define static keys, dynamic keys derived from input data, and reusable schema definitions.

keys.description:
Dictionary of dictionary-keys in the format `{<keyname>: {<schema>}}`.
`keyname` must use `snake_case`.
`schema` is the schema for each key. This is a recursive schema, so the value must conform to AVD Schema

dynamic_keys.description:
Dictionary of dynamic keys in the format `{<variable.path>: <schema>}`.
The dot-notation path is relative to the input dictionary being validated and points to
values containing additional key names. When a path traverses a list, every list item
is unpacked. Each resulting key is validated using the supplied schema.
These key names come from the input data or, when the input path has no value,
from schema-defined defaults if available.

allow_other_keys.description:
Whether input keys absent from `keys` and resolved `dynamic_keys` are accepted.
Default is false.

relaxed_validation.description:
Whether required-key validation is disabled for descendants.
Default is false.

$id.description: Identifier carried by the authored schema document.

$schema.description: Metaschema identifier carried by the authored schema document.

$ref.description:
Reference to another AVD schema or schema fragment, inherited by this schema.
Use a named schema followed by a JSON Pointer, for example
`eos_cli_config_gen#/keys/hostname` or `eos_cli_config_gen#/$defs/shared`.
A reference ending in `#` imports the complete root dictionary. Local properties override
inherited properties, and the referenced schema must have the same type.

dynamic_valid_values.description:
Dot-notation paths to variables under the parent input dictionary containing valid values.
For example, `interfaces.name` collects interface names from a list of dictionaries.
When a path traverses a list, every list item is unpacked.
Valid values are derived from the input data, not from the schema document.

convert_to_lower_case.description:
Convert string value to lower case before performing validation
Default is false.

pattern.description:
An AVD regular expression which will be matched against the complete variable value.
The supported dialect includes Unicode-aware Perl shorthand classes (`\d`, `\s`, and
`\w`, including their uppercase complements) and word boundaries, Unicode-safe wildcards
and explicit character classes, lookarounds, and variable-length lookbehinds.
Broader Unicode properties and scripts such as `\p{Greek}` are not supported.
Remember to double backslashes when using a YAML double-quoted string or a JSON string.

primary_key.description:
Name of a primary key in a list of dictionaries.
The configured key is implicitly required and must have unique values between the list elements

unique_keys.description: List of keys or dot-notation path keys that must be unique in addition to `primary_key`.

allow_duplicate_primary_key.description:
Set to True to allow duplicate `primary_key` values for a list of dicts.
Useful when primary key is only used for triggering documentation.
NOTE! Should only be used in `avd_design` inputs since we cannot merge on primary key if there are duplicate entries.
Default is false.

DocumentationOptions.description: Settings used for generating documentation for all other types than dict.

table.description:
Setting `table` will allow for custom grouping of schema fields in the documentation.
By default each root key has its own table. By setting the same table-value on multiple keys, they will be merged to a single table.
If `table` is set on a 'child' key, all 'ancestor' keys are automatically included in the table so the full path is visible.
The `table` option is inherited to all child keys, unless specifically set on the child.
Authored names must contain only lowercase ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.

IntConvertType.description: Schema representation of the values accepted by integer conversion.

Format.description: Format used to validate a string.

StrConvertType.description: Schema representation of the values accepted by string conversion.

MetaObject.description:
Schema-only replacement for `OrderMap<String, Value>`, which cannot implement
`JsonSchema` because both the trait and type are external.

hide_keys.description:
Prevent keys of the dict from being displayed in the generated documentation.
This is used for `structured_config` where we wish to avoid displaying the full `eos_config` schema everywhere.
Default is false.
